entities.name: B8HVK5 TsaD
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Cyanothece sp. UniProt B8HVK5; annotated as tRNA N6-adenosine threonylcarbamoyltransferase (EC 2.3.1.234).
Transfers threonylcarbamoyl from threonylcarbamoyl-AMP to N6 of tRNA adenosine 37 to form t6A37; annotation describes TsaD as likely directly catalytic and notes TsaB/TsaE participation.
Reviewed annotation reports one Fe2+ ion per subunit.

entities.name: RHEA:37059 t6A formation
observations: L-threonylcarbamoyladenylate + adenosine(37) in tRNA = N6-L-threonylcarbamoyladenosine(37) in tRNA + AMP + H+.
Catalytic reaction assigned from reviewed homolog annotations; sequence exactly matches reviewed B8HVK5, although its wording qualifies the direct role of TsaD as likely.
